checks.name: producer source stayed unchanged during independent increment

limits: This increment currently covers Canvas attachment deformation and the Chelsea actual-mesh shoulder; Monk checks await its frozen production contract.
Actual rays cover two canvas shells and the metal bore; laces and the independent tongue are separate actual meshes, not a claim of an empty space through the entire shoe.
The prescribed geometric bend and rigid constraints do not solve forces or establish wearer fit.
